text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain Middle East Bank posts net profit of $9.5 million in 1996, up 70 percent on the previous year's $5.6 million.
- Bahrain arrests suspects in an arson attack on a building in Tubli village last week in which an Asian was killed and two were injured.
- Al-Ahli Commercial Bank posts six million dinar net profit in 1996.
- Contract to build a 200 million dinar power station in Bahrain will be signed this month, electricity and water minister says.
